snippet.title: Echoes of Mora - Official PC Demo Trailer (Deutsche Indie Showcase)
snippet.description:
🎮 Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870460/Echoes_of_Mora_Demo/

As seen in Deutsche Indie Showcase December 2025: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XGj1ivg_FCc

🌊 What is Echoes of Mora?
In Echoes of Mora, you plunge into the depths of a mysterious lake to explore a sunken village. Through time portals, you travel into the village's past and meet a young girl named Mora. Discover forgotten secrets, solve environmental puzzles, and weave past and present into a fateful adventure. Coming to Steam in March 2026.

🦭 About Selkies Interactive
Founded in 2023 by game design students in Berlin, Selkies Interactive creates immersive story-driven worlds. Their debut title "Echoes of Mora" is part of the Games Incubator at HTW Berlin and supported by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg.

🎶 Echoes of Mora Soundtrack by: https://www.youtube.com/@FedericoTruzzi
